findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so it defaults to false and the CMK's key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius of a key compromise and conflicts with common cryptographic key management requirements for keys protecting log data.

No policy argument is defined, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the account root full control, which lets any IAM principal that can be granted kms:* use, administer, or schedule deletion of the key. There is no least-privilege boundary around the key protecting the logs bucket.
